programs.title: The Octonauts
programs.desc: The Octonauts journey across a dangerous expanse of ice to help a penguin mother get back to her family.

programs.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programs.desc: Music Is Everywhere: Nia is excited to see a concert, but when she gets stranded and cannot attend, Thomas decides to take the concert to her.

programs.title: Play School
programs.desc: Abi and Luke meet Ben, a friendly and helpful nurse! Luke uses craft materials to make his own stethoscope, and Jemima visits Dr Kiya at hospital for an x-ray! Through The Windows, we see more medical workers in an animation.

programs.title: Fireman Sam
programs.desc: A hunt for dinosaur bones leads to a search and rescue mission with the Police Helicopter, FireSwift, Radar and Shadow!

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: Miffy and her dad are planning a secret campsite in the garden. No one knows... but Miffy is so excited to go on this Father-Daughter camping trip that she ends up talking about it and inviting everyone.

programs.title: The Woohoos!
programs.desc: When Ellie digs up a carrot, she's disappointed to discover it's all wonky. Together, the Woohoos work out how some carrots grow wonkily - and that being wonky doesn't stop it being a juicy, delicious carrot!

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Nana Night
programs.desc: Amma and Appa are going out so Nana is babysitting - it's Nana Night! But will the boys get to sleep before they turn into grouchy, sleepy monsters?

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: During a beach party at school, Prince Wednesday spills paint on his pants and the floor! He's really upset, but telling Teacher Harriet what happened makes him feel so much better.

programs.title: Mittens & Pants
programs.desc: Pants learns hardworking Winkles the mouse is finally taking a day off. But he is still fixing things for everyone. So Pants tries to catch up to Winkles to make sure no one asks him for more work!

programs.title: BeddyByes
programs.desc: Join best friends MeMo and BaBa as they travel across the remarkable Planet BeddyByes, meeting new and familiar faces on their mindful and soothing journey to bedtime.

programs.title: Mixmups
programs.sub_title: Mixmups And The Up, Up, Up Balloons
programs.desc: The Mixmups go on an adventure to find out what the clouds taste like. When they can't reach up to the sky, will they find another way to discover how they taste?

programs.title: Ready Eddie Go!
programs.desc: Eddie is at school for art class, learning about coming up with ideas and how to turn a mistake into a masterpiece.
